principles: Make manual fallback mechanically visible at recovery entrypoints.
Keep valid init_check_repair fallback usable without adding new hard blockers.
Pin exact user-visible wording with focused smoke tests.
drivers: Agents can confuse process analysis with permission to continue an external story.
init_check_repair is already a signed, audited fallback and must not be weakened.
session_brief and story_get are the first surfaces agents read after context switches.

options.name: render-warning-only
pros: Low risk and does not alter lifecycle semantics
Directly addresses the misleading recovery text
Easy to test in the existing fallback smoke
cons: Still relies on the agent reading the warning

options.name: hard-block-fallback-continuation
pros: Forces explicit action before every fallback story continues
cons: Would break legitimate no-subagent environments and overreach beyond the current problem

options.name: do-nothing
cons: Leaves the B-4f98 class of cross-project continuation confusion unfixed

rationale: A warning-only recovery guard solves the observed UX problem without changing signed init-check semantics or making valid fallback stories harder to use.

preMortem.scenario: Warning only appears in story_get but not session_brief.
preMortem.trigger: Agent resumes from session_brief and never calls story_get.
preMortem.consequence: The same B-4f98 confusion can recur.
preMortem.mitigation: Render fallback warning in session_brief active-story and main active-story resume views.

preMortem.trigger: Text says fallback bypassed reviewers without explaining it is a legal manual attestation.
preMortem.consequence: Agents may unnecessarily roll back valid stories.
preMortem.mitigation: Phrase as legal manual fallback that does not replace later gates.

preMortem.trigger: Smoke coverage misses user-visible next-step text.
preMortem.consequence: Regressions can remove the visible guard while story_get still passes.
preMortem.mitigation: Assert session_brief contains the warning and explicit authorization boundary.
